historical_commentary.text: This note provides a comprehensive checklist for quality-assuring a 4D-based application before delivery to end users. While the specific items would reference 4D v6 features, the concept of a preflight/QA checklist before deployment is timeless software engineering practice. Modern 4D development would use different tools (automated testing, CI/CD) but the systematic review approach remains valuable.
related_updates: Modern 4D supports unit testing and automated build processes that complement manual checklists
4D's Build Application dialog and deployment tools have significantly evolved since v6
